flightSteps.label: / How we work
flightSteps.heading:
TAKE FLIGHT
STEP BY STEP
flightSteps.desc: From idea to launch to growth, a clear path forward.

items.title: Start with your idea
items.body: We align on your vision and see the full potential behind what you're building.

items.title: Plan the execution
items.body: We bring structure and clarity, mapping the smartest path from concept to product.

items.title: Build the MVP
items.body: We turn the idea into a focused product through fast, precise execution.

items.title: Launch & improve
items.body: We observe real-world usage and refine the product through continuous learning and iteration.

items.title: Support your growth
items.body: We stay with your product as it evolves, ensuring it scales with stability, precision, and long-term direction.

process.label: / Process
process.heading: HOW WE WORK
process.desc: Honest, async-first, and structured around early feedback. Every engagement follows this sequence.

items.title: Deep discovery
items.body: We spend the first week in your codebase, your data, and your user interviews. No proposals until we understand the real problem — not the stated one.

items.title: Working software fast
items.body: You see real, running code in week two. Not a prototype, not a Figma. This creates honest feedback loops and surfaces assumptions early when they are cheap to fix.

items.title: Relentless iteration
items.body: Bi-weekly demos, async standups, shared task board. You have full visibility into progress without needing to attend meetings to feel informed.

items.title: Clean handoff
items.body: Your team walks away owning the system. Full documentation, recorded architecture walkthroughs, and a support window. We optimize for your independence, not our perpetual engagement.

story.label: / Our story
story.heading: BUILT BY FRIENDS.
story.p1: We started as friends who grew up together, each following different paths in technology, design, and engineering, until those paths naturally crossed again with a shared drive to build things the right way.
story.p2: Today, we're a studio where diverse expertise comes together under one roof to turn ideas into complete software systems. We're building a long-term partner for products that evolve, scale, and last.

items.quote: StrixAlba operates at a level of technical depth that most agencies cannot match. They found problems in our architecture we didn't know we had — and fixed them without drama.
items.name: Sofia Reinholt

items.quote: We had been burned by two previous firms. StrixAlba was the opposite experience in every way. Direct communication, senior execution, on time.
items.name: Marcus Adeyemi

items.quote: The AI pipeline they built became a core competitive advantage within three months of launch. That's not a typical agency outcome.
items.name: Priya Nair
